blocks.value: What is Pearl Academy Entrance Exam?

Pearl Academy was established in 1993. It offers Design, Fashion, and Business programs. To get admission in any program offered by this design college, aspirants need to appear for the Pearl Academy Entrance Exam (which is also commonly called the PAF Entrance Exam), followed by a Personal Interview round. In each admission cycle of Pearl Academy, a separate written entrance exam and a personal interview round are conducted. Aspirants can get admission in various Bachelor's, Master's, and Professional courses offered at Pearl Academy by clearing the written entrance exam and interview round.
